artifact_check_scope: 15 one-off data/policy consistency assertions, not additional unittest cases or a runtime evidence engine. Negative-seat timestamp rule is vacuous here: no negative inventory observation was made.
checked_at_semantics: Public evidence audit completed at checked_at, with observations in the stated session window. Inventory checked_at is null because no authenticated inventory was accessed.

current_public_surcharge_reference.journey_scope: Applicable published CX sectors for a journey starting in Hong Kong; other journey origins/carriers require their own rules.

evidence_reuse_graph.minimality_reason: Every one of the six route/date packets has at least one distinct dated directional requirement. No packet can supply another date or destination. Three broad bundles AKL/SYD/CTS touch all families but do NOT verify every component; ZRH still mandatory for full coverage.
evidence_reuse_graph.minimum_definition: Six route/date roundtrip research packets cover all requirements. They contain 12 directional schedules and 16 cabin-specific inventory obligations, not six guaranteed API/UI calls.

manual_cathay_plan.limitations: Lower bounds, not a promise about UI. One-way-only UI needs eight promoted or sixteen all-family searches; final mixed-ticket pricing, taxes, funding and ticketability can require additional steps. No future monitoring automation created.

privacy: Anonymous traveler IDs and estimated spend only. No balances, account/member identifiers, credentials, personal screenshots or PII.
